transforms:
ImageClassification(
    crop_size=[224]
    resize_size=[256]
    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406]
    std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
    interpolation=InterpolationMode.BILINEAR
)
confidence: softmax probability of the top-1 predicted class
selection_rule: Candidate pool = original validation image indices 1..128. In original numerical order, select the first 5 distinct ground-truth classes within each A/B/C/D group. No heatmaps or confidence ranking used.
primary_xai_target: Each model own top-1 predicted class
supplementary_xai_target: Same ground-truth class for both models on B/C/D
limitations: Case selection is conditioned on prediction correctness; the selected 20 images cannot estimate population accuracy. The first 128 form a small, non-random candidate pool. Correctness uses the supplied dataset single-label ground truth.
